title: Natural Events Formula Engine Configuration Schema

mode.description: Execution mode: dry_run bypasses GUI/CLI interactivity and file writes; measurements executes full interactive/automated pipeline.

raw_folder.description: Path to the folder containing raw input images.

processed_folder.description: Path to the folder where processed images will be saved.

output_csv.description: Path to the CSV file where measurement results will be written.

grid_size_in_millimeters.description: Physical size of each grid cell in millimeters.

millimeters_per_pixel.description: Camera calibration factor: how many millimeters correspond to one pixel.

text_size.description: Font size for grid cell labels.

text_color.description: Hex color code for text labels (e.g., #FFFF00).

grid_color.description: Hex color code for grid lines.

grid_thickness.description: Thickness of grid lines in pixels.
